from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialResult(BaseModel):
    """A financial metric extracted from a single document, capturing the value necessary to compare periods."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the document pertains to")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year the financial data represents")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The specific line item label (e.g., 'Net Income', 'Net Loss')")
    amount_signed: float | None = Field(description="The monetary value as a signed float; negative values typically indicate losses")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported amount (e.g., 'millions', 'thousands')")
    quote: str = Field(description="A verbatim excerpt from the document anchoring the data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_results: list[FinancialResult]
